# Reading affordances

::: {.theorem #thm-fix}
A continuous map of a compact convex set into itself has a fixed point.
:::

Hover @thm-fix to preview its statement; hovering the box reveals a `#` that copies a
deep link to it.

::: {.proof collapse="true"}
Apply Brouwer's theorem to the simplex and pass to the limit.
:::
